quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct inference.
quests.passage: [Morning Routine] Every morning, Liam makes his bed and feeds his dog before eating breakfast.
quests.question: What can you infer about Liam?
options: He wakes up in the afternoon.
He follows a regular morning routine.
He never eats breakfast.
He dislikes taking care of pets.
quests.correctAnswer: He follows a regular morning routine.
quests.hint: Look at the order of small tasks he repeats every day.
quests.explanation: Doing the same things every morning shows that Liam follows a regular routine, even though the word is never used.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct inference.
quests.passage: [Missing Grandmother] Mia hugs her grandmother tightly and says she has missed her so much.
quests.question: What can you infer about Mia and her grandmother?
options: They see each other every single day.
They are meeting for the very first time.
They had an argument recently.
They have not seen each other in a while.
quests.correctAnswer: They have not seen each other in a while.
quests.hint: Think about why someone would say they 'missed' another person.
quests.explanation: Saying you missed someone usually means time has passed since you last spent time together.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct inference.
quests.passage: [Before the Test] Before the test, Noah reviews his notes one more time and sharpens two pencils.
quests.question: What can you infer about Noah?
options: He already knows he will fail.
He plans to skip the test.
He wants to be well prepared for the test.
He forgot the test was today.
quests.correctAnswer: He wants to be well prepared for the test.
quests.hint: Consider why someone would review notes and prepare pencils beforehand.
quests.explanation: Reviewing notes and preparing pencils shows Noah is getting ready carefully, which suggests he wants to do well.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct inference.
quests.passage: [The Price Tag] At the store, Ana checks the price tag twice and puts the jacket back on the shelf.
quests.question: What can you infer about Ana's decision?
options: She thinks the jacket is too expensive.
She thinks the jacket is too cheap.
She works at the store.
She already owns ten jackets.
quests.correctAnswer: She thinks the jacket is too expensive.
quests.hint: Think about what checking a price twice and returning an item usually means.
quests.explanation: Checking the price twice and putting the jacket back suggests Ana decided it cost more than she wanted to pay.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct inference.

quests.correctAnswer: The soup is very spicy or hot.
quests.hint: Think about why someone would need water right after a bite of food.
quests.explanation: Reaching for water right after tasting the soup suggests it is spicy or very hot, even though this is never stated directly.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct inference.

It is likely raining outside.
quests.correctAnswer: It is likely raining outside.
quests.hint: Think about when people usually carry an umbrella and wear rain boots.
quests.explanation: Umbrellas and rain boots are used to stay dry, so Sam is likely preparing for rain.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct inference.

quests.explanation: Coughing and staying in bed instead of going to work both point to Ellie not feeling well.

quests.explanation: Stopping immediately every time the phone buzzes shows that checking it is a frequent habit for David.
